verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents an official hosted MCP server (mcp.cal.com, or a local instance) with OAuth sign-in. It lets any MCP-compatible client manage bookings, event types, and schedules. Separately, agent docs describe API v2 and an official CLI that let agents check availability, create bookings, and manage event types. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and the MCP docs do not explicitly list availability-slot querying among the server's tools.
